# Gallery

Each app is one file. `dotnet run <file>.cs` runs it; `dotnet publish <file>.cs` makes one NativeAOT
executable. The line count leaves out comments, blank lines and the `Platform` block at the end,
which every app shares unchanged.

## gitview.cs

Branches → commits → changed files → diff, plus a Fetch button. **47 lines.**

![gitview](gitview.png)

```csharp
#:package Aprillz.MewUI@0.22.1
#:package Naratteu.MewShell.MewUI@0.1.0-preview.1

// Branches → commits → changed files → diff, plus a Fetch button. Run: dotnet run gitview.cs [repo]

using Aprillz.MewUI;
using Aprillz.MewUI.Controls;
using MewShell;
using MewShell.MewUI;
using static MewShell.Shell;

var git = Session.Default.In(args.FirstOrDefault() ?? ".");
var status = new ObservableValue<string>("");

// What the user picks. Each one becomes an argument of the next command.
var branch = new ObservableValue<string?>("main");
var commit = new ObservableValue<Commit?>(null);
var change = new ObservableValue<Change?>(null);

// What each command printed, kept current: a new pick re-runs it and kills the old run.
var branches = git.Query(() => Sh($"git for-each-ref --format=%(refname:short) refs/heads"), r => r.Lines());
var commits = git.Query(branch, b => Sh($"git log --date=short --format=%h%x09%ad%x09%s -n 300 {b}"), Commit.Parse);
var changes = git.Query(commit, c => Sh($"git show --numstat --format= {c.Hash}"), Change.Parse);
var diff = git.Query(commit, change, (c, f) => Sh($"git show --format= {c.Hash} -- {f.Path}"), r => r.Stdout);

async void Fetch()
{
    status.Value = "Fetching…";
    var result = await git.NoThrow().Sh($"git fetch --prune").RunAsync();
    status.Value = result.ExitCode == 0 ? "Fetched." : result.Stderr.Trim();
    branches.Refresh();
}

Application.Create().UseThisOS()
    .BuildMainWindow(() => new Window().Title("Git").Resizable(1100, 720).Content(
        new DockPanel().Spacing(10).Margin(16).Children(
            new StackPanel().Horizontal().Spacing(8).DockTop().Children(
                new ComboBox().Width(220).Bind(branches, branch),
                new Button().Content("Fetch").OnClick(Fetch),
                new TextBlock().BindText(status).CenterVertical()),
            new Grid().Columns("440,*").Rows("2*,3*").Spacing(10).Children(
                new ListBox().RowSpan(2).Bind(commits, commit, c => $"{c.Hash}  {c.Date}  {c.Subject}"),
                new GridView().Column(1).Bind(changes, change).Columns(
                    new GridViewColumn<Change>().Header("+").PixelWidth(56).Text(c => c.Added),
                    new GridViewColumn<Change>().Header("−").PixelWidth(56).Text(c => c.Deleted),
                    new GridViewColumn<Change>().Header("File").StarWidth().Text(c => c.Path)),
                new ScrollViewer().Row(1).Column(1).Content(
                    new TextBlock().Top().BindText(diff.Value, d => d ?? "").FontFamily(Platform.Mono).FontSize(11))))))
    .Run();

record Commit(string Hash, string Date, string Subject)
{
    public static IReadOnlyList<Commit> Parse(ShResult r) => [.. r.Fields().Select(f => new Commit(f[0], f[1], f[2]))];
}

record Change(string Added, string Deleted, string Path)
{
    public static IReadOnlyList<Change> Parse(ShResult r) => [.. r.Fields().Select(f => new Change(f[0], f[1], f[2]))];
}

static class Platform
{
    // One file for every OS: register the host and renderer of the one it runs on.
    public static string Mono => OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? "Consolas" : OperatingSystem.IsMacOS() ? "Menlo" : "monospace";

    public static ApplicationBuilder UseThisOS(this ApplicationBuilder app) =>
        OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? app.UseWin32().UseDirect2D()
        : OperatingSystem.IsMacOS() ? app.UseMacOS().UseMewVGMetal()
        : app.UseX11().UseMewVGX11();
}
```

## issues.cs

GitHub repositories → issues (with a search box) → issue body, from gh JSON. **38 lines.**

![issues](issues.png)

```csharp
#:package Aprillz.MewUI@0.22.1
#:package Naratteu.MewShell.MewUI@0.1.0-preview.1

// GitHub repositories → issues (with a search box) → issue body, from gh JSON. Run: dotnet run issues.cs [owner]

using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using Aprillz.MewUI;
using Aprillz.MewUI.Controls;
using MewShell;
using MewShell.MewUI;
using static MewShell.Shell;

var owner = args.FirstOrDefault() ?? "naratteu";
var gh = Session.Default;

// What the user picks or types. Each one becomes an argument of a gh command.
var repo = new ObservableValue<Repo?>(null);
var search = new ObservableValue<string?>("");
var issue = new ObservableValue<Issue?>(null);

// gh prints JSON with --json; the generated context below parses it without reflection.
var repos = gh.Query(() => Sh($"gh repo list {owner} --limit 50 --json name,description,stargazerCount"),
    r => (IReadOnlyList<Repo>)JsonSerializer.Deserialize(r.Stdout, Json.Default.RepoArray)!);
var issues = gh.Query(repo, search, (r, s) => Sh($"gh issue list -R {owner}/{r.Name} --state all --limit 100 --search {s} --json number,title,state"),
    r => (IReadOnlyList<Issue>)JsonSerializer.Deserialize(r.Stdout, Json.Default.IssueArray)!);
var body = gh.Query(repo, issue, (r, i) => Sh($"gh issue view {i.Number} -R {owner}/{r.Name} --json body --jq .body"), r => r.Stdout);

Application.Create().UseThisOS()
    .BuildMainWindow(() => new Window().Title($"Issues — {owner}").Resizable(1100, 700).Content(
        new Grid().Columns("380,*").Rows("Auto,*,2*").Spacing(10).Margin(16).Children(
            // Network commands take a moment: say so, and say why when one fails.
            new TextBlock().BindText(repos.Running, busy => busy ? "Loading repositories…" : "").CenterVertical(),
            new GridView().Row(1).RowSpan(2).Bind(repos, repo).Columns(
                new GridViewColumn<Repo>().Header("Repository").StarWidth().Text(r => r.Name),
                new GridViewColumn<Repo>().Header("★").PixelWidth(40).Text(r => r.StargazerCount.ToString())),
            new TextBox().Column(1).BindText(search!),
            new ListBox().Row(1).Column(1).Bind(issues, issue, i => $"#{i.Number}  {i.State,-6}  {i.Title}"),
            new ScrollViewer().Row(2).Column(1).Content(
                new TextBlock().Top().BindText(body.Value, b => b ?? "").TextWrapping(TextWrapping.Wrap)),
            new TextBlock().Row(2).Column(1).BindText(issues.Error, e => e ?? "").VerticalAlignment(VerticalAlignment.Bottom))))
    .Run();

record Repo(string Name, string? Description, int StargazerCount);
record Issue(int Number, string Title, string State);

[JsonSourceGenerationOptions(PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonKnownNamingPolicy.CamelCase)]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(Repo[]))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(Issue[]))]
partial class Json : JsonSerializerContext;

static class Platform
{
    // One file for every OS: register the host and renderer of the one it runs on.
    public static string Mono => OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? "Consolas" : OperatingSystem.IsMacOS() ? "Menlo" : "monospace";

    public static ApplicationBuilder UseThisOS(this ApplicationBuilder app) =>
        OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? app.UseWin32().UseDirect2D()
        : OperatingSystem.IsMacOS() ? app.UseMacOS().UseMewVGMetal()
        : app.UseX11().UseMewVGX11();
}
```

## procs.cs

Processes polled every two seconds, filtered by a text box, with Kill on the selected row. **47 lines.**

![procs](procs.png)

```csharp
#:package Aprillz.MewUI@0.22.1
#:package Naratteu.MewShell.MewUI@0.1.0-preview.1

// Processes polled every two seconds, filtered by a text box, with Kill on the selected row. Run: dotnet run procs.cs

using Aprillz.MewUI;
using Aprillz.MewUI.Controls;
using MewShell;
using MewShell.MewUI;
using static MewShell.Shell;

var filter = new ObservableValue<string?>("");
var picked = new ObservableValue<Proc?>(null);
var status = new ObservableValue<string>("");

// The filter is an input, so typing re-runs the query; the timer re-runs it every two seconds.
var procs = Session.Default.Query(filter, f => Sh($"ps -axo pid=,pcpu=,rss=,comm="), r => Proc.Parse(r, filter.Value ?? ""));
var poll = new DispatcherTimer(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
poll.Tick += procs.Refresh;
poll.Start();

async void Kill()
{
    if (picked.Value is not { } p) return;
    var result = await Session.Default.NoThrow().Sh($"kill {p.Pid}").RunAsync();
    status.Value = result.ExitCode == 0 ? $"Sent TERM to {p.Pid}." : result.Stderr.Trim();
    procs.Refresh();
}

Application.Create().UseThisOS()
    .BuildMainWindow(() => new Window().Title("Processes").Resizable(820, 560).Content(
        new DockPanel().Spacing(8).Margin(16).Children(
            new StackPanel().Horizontal().Spacing(8).DockTop().Children(
                new TextBox().Width(240).Placeholder("Filter by name").BindText(filter!),
                new Button().Content("Kill").OnClick(Kill).Bind(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, picked, p => p is not null),
                new TextBlock().BindText(status).CenterVertical()),
            new GridView().Bind(procs, picked).Columns(
                new GridViewColumn<Proc>().Header("PID").PixelWidth(80).Text(p => p.Pid),
                new GridViewColumn<Proc>().Header("CPU %").PixelWidth(70).Text(p => p.Cpu),
                new GridViewColumn<Proc>().Header("MB").PixelWidth(70).Text(p => p.Mb),
                new GridViewColumn<Proc>().Header("Command").StarWidth().Text(p => p.Command)))))
    .Run();

record Proc(string Pid, string Cpu, string Mb, string Command)
{
    // A row is the same process across refreshes even when its numbers move, so the selection survives polling.
    public virtual bool Equals(Proc? other) => other?.Pid == Pid;
    public override int GetHashCode() => Pid.GetHashCode();

    // ps pads its columns with spaces, and the command may contain spaces too: split off three fields only.
    public static IReadOnlyList<Proc> Parse(ShResult r, string filter) =>
    [
        .. r.Lines()
            .Select(line => line.Trim().Split(' ', 4, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries))
            .Where(f => f.Length == 4 && f[3].Contains(filter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .Select(f => new Proc(f[0], f[1], $"{long.Parse(f[2]) / 1024}", f[3]))
            .OrderByDescending(p => double.Parse(p.Cpu, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
    ];
}

static class Platform
{
    // One file for every OS: register the host and renderer of the one it runs on.
    public static string Mono => OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? "Consolas" : OperatingSystem.IsMacOS() ? "Menlo" : "monospace";

    public static ApplicationBuilder UseThisOS(this ApplicationBuilder app) =>
        OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? app.UseWin32().UseDirect2D()
        : OperatingSystem.IsMacOS() ? app.UseMacOS().UseMewVGMetal()
        : app.UseX11().UseMewVGX11();
}
```

## pinger.cs

A long-running command streamed line by line, with Stop. **33 lines.**

![pinger](pinger.png)

```csharp
#:package Aprillz.MewUI@0.22.1
#:package Naratteu.MewShell.MewUI@0.1.0-preview.1

// A long-running command streamed line by line, with Stop. Run: dotnet run pinger.cs

using Aprillz.MewUI;
using Aprillz.MewUI.Controls;
using MewShell;
using static MewShell.Shell;

var host = new ObservableValue<string>("127.0.0.1");
var log = new ObservableValue<string>("");
var running = new ObservableValue<bool>(false);
CancellationTokenSource? stop = null;

// A long-running command: lines are appended as they arrive, and Stop kills the process.
async void Ping()
{
    stop = new CancellationTokenSource();
    running.Value = true;
    log.Value = "";
    try
    {
        await foreach (var line in Session.Default.Scoped(stop.Token).Sh($"ping -c 20 {host.Value}").StreamAsync())
            log.Value += line + "\n";
    }
    catch (OperationCanceledException) { log.Value += "— stopped —\n"; }
    catch (Exception error) { log.Value += error.Message + "\n"; }
    finally { running.Value = false; }
}

Application.Create().UseThisOS()
    .BuildMainWindow(() => new Window().Title("Ping").Resizable(640, 420).Content(
        new DockPanel().Spacing(8).Margin(16).Children(
            new StackPanel().Horizontal().Spacing(8).DockTop().Children(
                new TextBox().Width(260).BindText(host),
                new Button().Content("Ping").OnClick(Ping).Bind(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, running, r => !r, r => !r),
                new Button().Content("Stop").OnClick(() => stop?.Cancel()).Bind(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, running)),
            new ScrollViewer().Content(new TextBlock().Top().BindText(log).FontFamily(Platform.Mono).FontSize(11)))))
    .Run();

static class Platform
{
    // One file for every OS: register the host and renderer of the one it runs on.
    public static string Mono => OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? "Consolas" : OperatingSystem.IsMacOS() ? "Menlo" : "monospace";

    public static ApplicationBuilder UseThisOS(this ApplicationBuilder app) =>
        OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? app.UseWin32().UseDirect2D()
        : OperatingSystem.IsMacOS() ? app.UseMacOS().UseMewVGMetal()
        : app.UseX11().UseMewVGX11();
}
```

## brewview.cs

Installed Homebrew formulae (filter, outdated only) → details of the picked one. **67 lines.**

![brewview](brewview.png)

```csharp
#:package Aprillz.MewUI@0.22.1
#:package Naratteu.MewShell.MewUI@0.1.0-preview.1

// Installed Homebrew formulae (filter, outdated only) → details of the picked one. Run: dotnet run brewview.cs

using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using Aprillz.MewUI;
using Aprillz.MewUI.Controls;
using MewShell;
using MewShell.MewUI;
using static MewShell.Shell;

// Read-only brew commands; never let one update the taps or print hints and colors.
// An app opened from Finder does not get the terminal's PATH, so name brew by its full path when it is there.
var exe = File.Exists("/opt/homebrew/bin/brew") ? "/opt/homebrew/bin/brew" : "brew";
var brew = Session.Default.With("HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE", "1").With("HOMEBREW_NO_ENV_HINTS", "1").With("NO_COLOR", "1");

// What the user types, toggles and picks.
var filter = new ObservableValue<string?>("");
var outdatedOnly = new ObservableValue<bool>(false);
var formula = new ObservableValue<Formula?>(null);

// The list: every installed formula, or only the outdated ones. The filter applies to the names.
var formulae = brew.Query(
    () => outdatedOnly.Value ? Sh($"{exe} outdated --formula --verbose") : Sh($"{exe} list --formula --versions"),
    r => Formula.Parse(r, filter.Value ?? ""));
filter.Changed += formulae.Refresh;
outdatedOnly.Changed += formulae.Refresh;

// The details of the picked formula.
var info = brew.Query(formula, f => Sh($"{exe} info --json=v2 {f.Name}"),
    r => JsonSerializer.Deserialize(r.Stdout, Json.Default.InfoResult)!.Formulae.FirstOrDefault());

Application.Create().UseThisOS()
    .BuildMainWindow(() => new Window().Title("Homebrew formulae").Resizable(1000, 640).Content(
        new DockPanel().Spacing(10).Margin(16).Children(
            new StackPanel().Horizontal().Spacing(8).DockTop().Children(
                new TextBox().Width(260).Placeholder("Filter by name").BindText(filter!),
                new CheckBox().Content("Outdated only").BindIsChecked(outdatedOnly).CenterVertical(),
                new TextBlock().BindText(formulae.Value, l => l is null ? "" : $"{l.Count} formulae").CenterVertical()),
            new TextBlock().DockTop().BindText(formulae.Error, e => e ?? "").BindIsVisible(formulae.Error, e => e is not null).TextWrapping(TextWrapping.Wrap),
            new Grid().Columns("340,*").Spacing(10).Children(
                new ListBox().Bind(formulae, formula, f => f.Latest is null ? $"{f.Name}  {f.Installed}" : $"{f.Name}  {f.Installed} → {f.Latest}"),
                new ScrollViewer().Column(1).Content(
                    new StackPanel().Top().Spacing(6).Children(
                        new TextBlock().BindText(info.Running, busy => busy ? "Loading…" : ""),
                        new TextBlock().BindText(info.Error, e => e ?? ""),
                        new TextBlock().BindText(info.Value, i => i?.Name ?? "Pick a formula").FontSize(20),
                        new TextBlock().BindText(info.Value, i => i?.Desc ?? "").TextWrapping(TextWrapping.Wrap),
                        new TextBlock().BindText(info.Value, Details).FontFamily(Platform.Mono).FontSize(12).TextWrapping(TextWrapping.Wrap)))))))
    .Run();

static string Details(Info? i) => i is null ? "" : string.Join("\n", (string[])[
    $"Installed:    {string.Join(", ", i.Installed.Select(v => v.Version))}",
    $"Latest:       {i.Versions.Stable}{(i.Revision > 0 ? $"_{i.Revision}" : "")}{(i.Outdated ? "  (outdated)" : "")}",
    $"Homepage:     {i.Homepage}",
    $"License:      {i.License ?? "—"}",
    $"Dependencies: {(i.Dependencies.Length == 0 ? "none" : "")}",
    .. i.Dependencies.Select(d => $"  {d}")]);

record Formula(string Name, string Installed, string? Latest)
{
    // The same formula across refreshes keeps the selection.
    public virtual bool Equals(Formula? other) => other?.Name == Name;
    public override int GetHashCode() => Name.GetHashCode();

    // "name 1.2 1.3" from brew list, or "name (1.2) < 1.3" from brew outdated --verbose.
    public static IReadOnlyList<Formula> Parse(ShResult r, string filter) =>
    [
        .. r.Lines()
            .Select(line => line.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries))
            .Where(f => f.Length >= 2 && f[0].Contains(filter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .Select(f => f.Contains("<")
                ? new Formula(f[0], string.Join(" ", f[1..Array.IndexOf(f, "<")]).Trim('(', ')'), f[^1])
                : new Formula(f[0], string.Join(" ", f[1..]), null)),
    ];
}

record InfoResult(Info[] Formulae);
record Info(string Name, string? Desc, string? Homepage, string? License, Versions Versions, Installed[] Installed, string[] Dependencies, int Revision, bool Outdated);
record Versions(string? Stable);
record Installed(string Version);

[JsonSourceGenerationOptions(PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonKnownNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower)]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(InfoResult))]
partial class Json : JsonSerializerContext;

static class Platform
{
    // One file for every OS: register the host and renderer of the one it runs on.
    public static string Mono => OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? "Consolas" : OperatingSystem.IsMacOS() ? "Menlo" : "monospace";

    public static ApplicationBuilder UseThisOS(this ApplicationBuilder app) =>
        OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? app.UseWin32().UseDirect2D()
        : OperatingSystem.IsMacOS() ? app.UseMacOS().UseMewVGMetal()
        : app.UseX11().UseMewVGX11();
}
```
